privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy policy for A-Shine - how we collect, use and protect your personal data.
privacy.whoWeAreBody: A-Shine ("we", "us") is the data controller for personal data processed through this website. We provide car detailing and mobile valeting services in Slovenia. This policy explains how we process and protect your personal data in line with the GDPR and applicable Slovenian law.
privacy.dataWeCollectIntro: When you use our booking form or contact us, we may collect:
privacy.dataWeCollect4: Service and location preferences (e.g. at our location or we come to you, distance)
privacy.dataWeCollect5: Preferred date and any message you send
privacy.howWeUse1: Process and respond to your booking or enquiry
privacy.howWeUse2: Send you a confirmation email when you submit a request
privacy.howWeUse3: Contact you about your booking (e.g. by phone or email)
privacy.howWeUse4: Improve our services and customer communication
privacy.legalBasisBody: We process your data under Article 6 GDPR: (a) consent, where applicable; (b) steps prior to entering into a contract and performance of a contract for bookings; and (c) legitimate interests, such as service quality and fraud prevention. We keep data only as long as necessary for booking management, customer communication, legal obligations, and defence of legal claims.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell your data. We may share data only with trusted processors that help us operate the website and services (for example email delivery, website hosting, and embedded maps), under appropriate agreements and safeguards. We implement reasonable technical and organizational security measures.
privacy.additionalProcessors: Depending on how you use the site, personal data you send via the booking form is transmitted to our email provider Resend to deliver messages to us and confirmation emails to you. The website is hosted on infrastructure that may process technical data needed to deliver pages and handle form requests (for example our hosting provider such as Vercel). When you view the service area map, Google (Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API) may process the address and related technical data in line with Google’s policies. International transfers, where they occur, rely on appropriate safeguards required by applicable law (such as Standard Contractual Clauses).
privacy.additionalSecurity: When you submit the booking form, our server may process your IP address briefly for rate limiting and abuse prevention. This is based on our legitimate interests in keeping the service secure and available.
privacy.additionalDevice: Your selected language is stored in your browser’s local storage. If you use the cookie banner, your consent choice is also stored locally so we do not repeat the prompt unnecessarily.
privacy.yourRightsBody: Under applicable data protection law (including GDPR where it applies), you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data, and to data portability or to object to processing. To exercise these rights or ask questions, contact us at
privacy.yourRightsSuffix: . You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner (Informacijski pooblaščenec).
privacy.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect legal, technical, or business changes. The "Last updated" date will be revised accordingly.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using A-Shine website and booking our car detailing services.
terms.agreementBody: By using the A-Shine website and submitting a booking request, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site or our services.
terms.servicesBody: A-Shine provides car detailing and mobile valeting services in Slovenia. Service areas, packages, and prices shown on the website are informational and may be adjusted based on vehicle condition, location, and requested scope. A booking becomes binding only after explicit confirmation (for example, by email or phone).
terms.bookingsBody: Submitting a booking request via the website does not itself create a binding contract. We will contact you to confirm availability, final scope, and price. Payment terms (for example, payment on completion or deposit) are agreed before service delivery. You are responsible for providing accurate and complete contact and vehicle information. Email delivery depends on our email provider (Resend) and your mailbox provider; we are not liable for delays caused by spam filters, incorrect addresses, or third-party outages.
terms.cancellationBody: If you need to cancel or reschedule, please contact us as soon as possible. Any cancellation conditions (including possible notice periods or cancellation fees) are communicated clearly during booking confirmation.
terms.useOfWebsiteBody: You must use the website lawfully and not attempt to interfere with its operation, security, or other users. Content on the site (text, images, etc.) is owned by us or our licensors and may not be copied or used without permission.
terms.liabilityBody: We perform services with due professional care. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law, including mandatory consumer protection rules in Slovenia. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.
terms.contactPrefix: For questions about these terms, contact us at
terms.contactSuffix: . These terms are governed by Slovenian law. We may update these terms from time to time; the "Last updated" date will be revised accordingly.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How A-Shine uses cookies and similar technologies on this website.
cookies.whatAreBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make sites work properly, remember preferences, and understand how visitors use the site.
cookies.howWeUseIntro: Our website uses or may use:
cookies.localeStorageNote: Your selected language is saved in your browser’s local storage (not in a first-party cookie). You can remove it by clearing site data for this website in your browser settings.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Required for the site to function (e.g. security, load balancing). These generally do not require consent under applicable law.
cookies.functionalDesc: Optional cookies for UI preferences if we enable them. Your language choice is stored in local storage, not cookies (see above).
cookies.analyticsDesc: We do not currently use first-party analytics cookies on this site. If we add analytics later, we will only use cookies according to your consent where the law requires it.
cookies.thirdPartyBody: Our site can embed Google Maps (Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API). When the map loads, Google may set or read cookies and process technical data according to Google’s terms and policies. We do not control Google’s cookies; adjust your browser or Google account settings as needed.
cookies.managingBody: We do not set any first-party cookies and our site does not display a cookie consent banner because of that. If you wish to block or delete the cookies set by Google Maps, use your browser settings or your Google account preferences.
cookies.updatesBody: We may update this cookie policy from time to time to reflect legal or technical changes. The "Last updated" date at the top will be revised accordingly.
cookies.contactPrefix: If you have questions about our use of cookies, contact us at
